text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka sounds half asleep as she murmurs under her breath.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yawn… A trip would be… so nice…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Rolling plains carpeted with verdant grass, and auroras dancing above in the sky…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I've been watching videos of scenery taken from all around the world recently.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My legs tingle just thinking about those vistas…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sigh… But before I knew it, it was already morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Silence Suzuka was so enthralled by the videos, it cut into her sleep. She certainly looks a little tired.
